stem: $\overline{AB}$ is a diameter of circle M, $m(\angle AMC) = 2x^\circ$ and $x = 25$. Complete: $m(\widehat{AC}) = \ldots^\circ$. Drag the points to set the measure of arc AC.
solution: The measure of an arc equals its central angle, so m(AC) = m(∠AMC) = 2x°.

hints.text: The arc is measured by its central angle directly. Check which angle you have set.
Check that you set the arc cut off by the angle at M, not the one across.
Replace x by its value in the central angle.
